summary: Meta released version 0.0.34 of the xFormers library, adding PyTorch 2.10+ stable API/ABI compatibility while removing the A100-specific SwiGLU fast-path and most legacy components.

practices.reason: Teams relying on the A100-optimized SwiGLU path or other legacy components must migrate their serving code since those components are removed in this release.
practices.quote: Removed optimized fast-path of SwiGLU (which was only available for A100 GPUs)

practices.reason: Migrating to the PyTorch stable API/ABI reduces future rebuild churn since binaries will keep working across later PyTorch versions, but requires no immediate action.
practices.quote: Migrated xFormers to the PyTorch stable API/ABI, which means that binary builds targeting PyTorch 2.10+ will be compatible with any later version
